pass_rule.rule: no SD reported: |model-mean| <= 15% of mean (algorithm error in paper ≈13%)

title: Maximal static right axial rotation moment vs flexion and twist angle, standing, males

source.authors: Gravel D, Gagnon M, Plamondon A, Desjardins P
source.sample: 10 subjects (10 M); healthy male college (physical education) students; separate group per muscle group

quantity.name: maximal static right axial rotation moment
quantity.definition: group mean maximal static right axial rotation moment about the longitudinal axis of the trunk (transducers on the shoulder-level frame)

protocol.summary: Standing, knees extended, feet stabilised with wooden blocks; pelvis stabilised by a posterior sacral pad and two anterior pads over the ASIS; upper trunk constrained in a padded rigid frame at shoulder level, supported by two vertical rods whose rotation set the flexion angle (flexion-extension axis aligned on the lateral projection of L5-S1). Asymmetric positions: pelvis rotated relative to trunk (twist ±30 deg, shoulders kept parallel to floor), then flexed. Moment = sum of moments from 4 force transducers; peak of each trial, gravity-corrected with a relaxed trial; mean of 3 maximal efforts (2 min rest) per position. Positive twist = left twisting of trunk relative to pelvis. Angles are 'adjusted' (dynamometer) angles; measured 3-D trunk angles were ~57% smaller in flexion (Table 5).
how_to_simulate: Standing, pelvis and legs fixed, upper trunk restrained at shoulder level
Set trunk flexion (adjusted angle -20..+60 deg) and twist (-30, 0, +30 deg; + = trunk twisted left relative to pelvis)
Maximal voluntary right axial rotation exertion; compare predicted maximal moment (longitudinal trunk axis (not stated relative to L5-S1)) with the group means
Use the measured (smaller) 3-D angles of Table 5 if the model posture is set from kinematics
protocol.notes: Right axial rotation increased with forward bending and with left twist (+30). No SDs.

extraction.from: Fig 5A (text: max 160 Nm at +60 flexion, +30 twist)
extraction.check_notes: Pixel digitisation; the +60/+30 point 158.6 Nm vs text 160 Nm. Symbols well separated.
